A new look, Tidelight. Today opens under a sky that follows the clock: misty at dawn, clear through the day, golden at dusk and deep teal at night. Light and dark still follow your setting.

The sun on Today's arc moves as you log food and sets at your target. Each meal lights its own piece of the arc, and the big number is what's left. Going over sets the sun with a soft glow, never red.

Your day reads as a timeline: what you ate, when, and its protein, each with its own slice of the arc. Tap an entry to edit it; touch and hold to repeat, add a photo or delete. When there's room, your usual next meal sits on the Now line, one tap from logging.

The week strip at the top of Today shows how each day went, and the This week row says what's banked and what the rest of the week can have. Protein leads the macros, and once your calories are spent it stops telling you to eat more.

Week is seven skies, filled to each day's target, with a running balance line and a plain answer for the days left. Details, averages and how the bank works are one tap away. The tab bar now floats; + logs food from any tab, and Settings is the sliders button on Today.
On wider phones like the Pro Max, the sky on Today and Week now reaches the edges of the screen, with no pale strip down each side or band under the clock.
Log with AI is back near the top of Today: one button opens Estimate with Gemini, Help me pick from a menu, and copy/paste for other chatbots. The + button is now just for typing a food in yourself.
Swipe the row of days at the top of Today sideways to step back a week, or forward again. It keeps the same weekday, jumps to today when you're back on this week, and stops at the current week.

The log sheet, AI sheets, Journal, Foods and Settings now match Today's look: outline-free cards, fields on the page colour, a white lens on the chosen side of toggles, your accent as a soft tint for picked chips, and Delete in red text instead of a beige button.

Estimate with Gemini gives home cooking per serving again. List what you cooked and it comes back as one serve; say how many serves the recipe made and it splits it for you. Single foods like a yoghurt off its label still go per 100 g times the grams you ate, and switching Per serving / Per 100g keeps the weight when Gemini knows it.

Free Gemini keys work again. Google took Pro models off its free tier, and Dawni was reading that as "needs billing" and stopping. Now it skips to Gemini Flash, which is free, and a paid key still gets the best model. Saving a key checks it straight away and Settings shows which model Dawni will use and whether the key is on the free tier.

Calories on Today now say their unit. Each meal on the timeline shows Cal (or kJ) under its number, so it can't be mistaken for the grams beside it, and the This week row reads "1,108 Cal over so far".

Search is back on Today, just above Log with AI. Tap it and your favourites and recent foods are there before you type, and typing searches the food database too. A heart marks a favourite, a clock a recent food and a dashed tile the food database, labelled Estimated or checked. Tap a food and Log food opens filled in. Nothing right? Log what you typed yourself.

Today no longer stamps food with the time you logged it. Your day reads as Morning, Afternoon and Evening instead: breakfast sits in the morning even if you log it at 1pm, lunch in the afternoon and dinner in the evening. Snacks and drinks ask which part of the day they were, and logging a few things in a row starts each one on the meal you just picked.

Log with AI is now the sparkle button beside the tabs, where your thumb already is, and it opens from any tab: Estimate with Gemini, Help me pick from a menu, and copy/paste for other chatbots, same as before. The row on Today is now Log manually, for typing in calories and macros yourself.

Meal prep. Cooked a batch for the week? Tap the sparkle, then Meal prep a batch: list what went in and how many serves. Gemini estimates the whole batch ingredient by ingredient, Dawni splits it into serves, and you can fix anything before saving. Each serve then sits on Today and at the top of Search, where one tap logs it (with Undo). Serves left count down from your log, so deleting an entry puts the serve back. A batch clears once it's eaten or a week after you cook it, and it never ends up in Recent or Favourites. Finished batches wait in Foods → Meal prep → Cook again, so making the same recipe again doesn't need a new estimate.

Tapping the macros on Today switches protein between left and eaten too, like carbs and fat. Before, protein stayed on eaten once your calories were spent or you'd hit your protein goal. Once calories are spent it says "left" rather than "to go", and past your goal it shows how far past.

Recent no longer fills up with one-off AI estimates. A food from Log with AI that you've only logged once, haven't hearted and haven't used for 30 days now clears from Recent and Search. Log it again, heart it or edit it in Foods and it stays. Labels read from a photo and foods you type in yourself always stay, and your diary keeps every entry exactly as you logged it.

New type. Titles and the big numbers are set in Fraunces, a soft, rounded serif, and everything else in Nunito, a rounded sans, so Dawni reads warmer and less like every other app. Both fonts come with the app, so they work offline, and shared meal cards use them too.

Easier to read and to tap. You can pinch to zoom again, no text is smaller than 11 px, and every button and chip is at least 44 px so a thumb finds it. With a sheet open, the page behind it is out of the way for a keyboard or screen reader, and focus goes back to where you were when it closes. Foods show a long name on two lines instead of cutting it off, a goal or macro like 1.5 can be typed in full, and this What's new list now shows the newest changes first.

Settings is one tap away on every tab, and Done takes you back to the tab you came from, on the day you were looking at. It's in a better order too: Goals, then your Gemini key, then About you, for AI, with Weekly banking, Display and Backup below.

Today leads with your log. Search foods and Log manually moved into the Log food sheet, so what you've eaten is on screen without scrolling. The sun, the big number and the macros glide to their new values when you log, edit or undo, and sheets follow your finger and carry on at its speed when you let go. If your phone is set to reduce motion, they cross-fade instead.

Setting up Gemini happens right where you need it. The first time you tap Estimate or Suggest without a key, a card there asks you to paste one, checks it works and carries on with what you'd typed. Your key stays on this phone and goes into your backups, and How do I get a key? is one tap from the card.

Tap to save, with Undo if it wasn't what you meant. A usual, a meal prep serve and Save on a reviewed estimate all log with one tap, and a toast with Undo stays for five seconds. Deleting an entry or a saved food works the same way, with no are-you-sure box. Clear local data and importing a backup still ask first.

Week now answers in plain numbers that add up, and counts today. A week that's 163 Cal behind says "163 to even out", and the days left read like "Sunday can have about 1,287 (1,450 − 163)". Under it sit your weekly budget, what's left, counted days and your average, with the day-by-day table in Details.

What should I eat? Say where you're going, what's in the fridge, or photograph a menu, and Dawni suggests dishes that fit what's left today and how your week is going, with the numbers shown. Pick one and it opens ready to log. It's the Suggest tab of the Log food sheet, and a chip on the Now line on Today.

Estimates never lock the screen. Describe or photograph a meal, tap Estimate, and Gemini carries on in the background: close the sheet, look at your week or log something else, and a pill above the tab bar shows it's still working. When it's ready a toast offers Review. A slow reply stops after 45 seconds and lets you try again or type it in.

One Log food sheet for everything. The sparkle opens it on any tab: describe what you ate or add a photo and tap Estimate, or tap one of your usuals to log it at once (hold to check it first). Search foods, Type it in, Rough meal and Meal prep a batch are one tap below, and pasting an estimate from another chatbot is still there. Estimates are labelled as estimates, and you check the numbers before anything is saved.

Meal prep is now the Fridge, and it takes food you bought too. Got two Muscle Chef meals for the week, or a tub of ice cream? Tap Add to fridge, choose I bought it, and snap the nutrition label: Gemini reads it, Dawni multiplies it by how many you bought and splits it into the label's serves (two ready meals are 2 serves, a tub of 8 scoops is 8). If your scoops are bigger, use fewer serves and each one grows to match. Each serve is then one tap from Today, like meal prep. Bought food stays for 60 days instead of a week, home cooking still clears after a week, and either clears once it's eaten. Add to fridge is first under Other ways in Log food, there's an Add button above your fridge on Today (or one slim row when it's empty), and Foods has a Fridge tab.

One box in Log food. Start typing and it searches as you go: your fridge, favourites, recent foods and the food database show up right under the box, in place of your usuals and Other ways. Tap a food to check it and log it, or a fridge serve to log it at once. Nothing there? Tap Estimate and Gemini works it out from what you typed, or log it yourself. Clear the box and your usuals come back. Search foods is gone from Other ways now that the box does it, and the sheet holds still while you type.
